en.headline: A Yoshi Edition 64GB microSD card, officially licensed for Nintendo Switch systems
en.intro: This SanDisk 64GB microSDXC card is the official licensed microSD card for Nintendo Switch systems, in the Yoshi Edition design, and it adds up to 64GB of extra space for games, screenshots and videos. Our concierge checked the model, variant, stock and price before listing; after you order, FeelBetter buys it from the seller in the United States and ships it to Korea, typically in 7–14 business days.
highlights: It is the official licensed microSD card for Nintendo Switch systems.
Write speeds of up to 90MB/s help you add games quickly.
Read speeds of up to 100MB/s help you start playing fast.
It adds up to 64GB of extra memory for your games, screenshots and videos.
It is a UHS-I, Class 10 microSDXC card in the black Yoshi Edition design.

sections.p: This card is made for Nintendo Switch systems. It is not designed for the Nintendo Switch 2, for which the listing recommends a separate SanDisk microSD Express card, so please choose another card if you own that console.

The card is a 64 GB microSDXC UHS-I, Class 10 model (SDSQXAO-064G-GN6ZN) and measures about 0.59 x 0.43 inches (1.5 x 1.1 cm). Speeds of up to 100MB/s read and 90MB/s write are based on internal testing, so real results can be lower depending on the device and conditions. The listing's feature list also names it as water proof.

cautions: Not compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2; it is made for Nintendo Switch systems.
The listed capacity counts 1GB as 1,000,000,000 bytes, so the storage you can actually use is less.

Die angegebene Kapazität rechnet 1 GB als 1.000.000.000 Bytes, daher ist der tatsächlich nutzbare Speicher geringer.

Notre concierge a vérifié le modèle, la variante, le stock et le prix avant la mise en ligne ; après votre commande, FeelBetter l'achète auprès du vendeur aux États-Unis et l'expédie en Corée, généralement en 7 à 14 jours ouvrés.
